g.text: Kimi K3: Streaming Speed and Throughput
Eight B300s; fixed conversation concurrency in each column; stages match the article
Speed = 1/P90 TPOT; total = input + output, including cached history.
Axes do not start at zero; use labeled values. See the stage table in the article.
TP8; add DCP8 at stage 3. Compact draft is separate; C70 is a final-load choice.
